sourceRefs: Codex and Codex2 share one ChatGPT account
Pantheon supervisor is the only routine implementation dispatcher
four operator V4 tasks contain false different-accounts and mutual-review acceptance
all four remain nonterminal and are replaced before implementation
G1 remains unmaterialized until V5 canary and legal dispatcher bootstrap

acceptance: Supersede operator V4 because its acceptance contains the false Codex/Codex2 independent-review policy. Start from current origin/dev only after the corrected shared identity guard V2 is merged.
Codex and Codex2 remain separate configured execution quota groups but one current review identity; this task must consume the shared predicate and may not authorize mutual review.
Reproduce the signed-packet receipts that timed out in canonical assign while later direct canonical assign succeeded; record exact lock owner and elapsed phases with scratch-root instrumentation.
Never wait on governed ai-status subprocesses while holding runtime-admission, task-state, event-log, inbox, or replay locks required by that subprocess.
Make transient task-state timeouts retryable with bounded backoff, exact packet identity replay protection, and at-most-once canonical materialization.
Require durable processed receipt, admission record, exact task-spec hash, and canonical active-or-archive readback for every task ID.
Add concurrent real-event-log integration tests with a full supervisor cycle plus approve, assign, note, reopen, and prove governed assign under two seconds p95.
Cover timeout-before-task, timeout-after-one, crash-after-rename, stale claim, forged retry, concurrent drainers, mismatched spec, and restart recovery.
Preserve provider dispatch, worker leases, shared reviewer eligibility, signature checks, artifact guards, journal integrity, and zero partial materialization.
Run focused bridge suites, relevant full supervisor regression, 2000-event benchmark, py_compile, evidence JSON, trailer, scope, and diff checks.
Do not edit config, live runtime, canonical JSON by hand, provider/account/quota policy, unrelated services, product tasks, or the fixed L12 catalog.
Deliver clean PR to dev, exact-head Human/Ops review, merge, and canonical archive before rollout. Rollback is merge revert.

acceptance: Supersede operator V4 because its acceptance contains false reviewer policy and omits the corrective identity and guarded-dispatcher dependencies.
Bind every accepted dependency to exact merged dev commit, green checks, independently reviewed exact head, and canonical completed archive.
Promote only through the reviewed transactional runtime promotion path with gate-before-switch and automatic rollback; never patch live source or config.
Codex and Codex2 remain distinct execution quota groups but one current review identity. Prove no fallback, approval, closeout, or merge gate treats them as independent reviewers.
Prove task-scoped live auth or quota unavailability triggers bounded legal owner/reviewer pair fallback; with no independent legal reviewer, fail closed with zero canonical mutation.

Rollback automatically on any identity, cadence, projection, lease, provider, config, or queue invariant failure and prove restored PID, root, commit, tree, config hash, and three fresh loops.
Do not materialize the fixed 28-task G1 frontier in this canary; successful canary only authorizes the separately guarded Antigravity dispatcher bootstrap and admission step.
Do not enable real writes, trading capital, product controllers, account policy changes, config edits, or manual canonical state edits.
